name: @absolutejs/meeting-discord
description: Discord voice source adapter for @absolutejs/meeting — a bot joins a Discord voice channel and streams per-participant audio (speakers known, no diarization needed) into the meeting core for live transcription + analysis
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/compile.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external @absolutejs/voice --external @absolutejs/meeting --external discord.js --external @discordjs/voice --external prism-media --external '@snazzah/*' && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.json
